source: Rendered from the game's own procedural first-person rifle model (buildRifleModel('127s') in src/player/rifle.ts), no hands, with three.js in headless Chrome
notes: Orthographic right-side view, muzzle to the right, on a grey studio gradient (#6e7072 to #55575a), 1240x400 to match the other rifle art. The image service declined this one, so it is a render of the in-game model instead.
